hypotheses.justification: In the Mathlib in this working directory, `ENNReal`'s inverse is `noncomputable instance : Inv ℝ≥0∞ := ⟨fun a => sInf { b | 1 ≤ a * b }⟩` (Mathlib/Basic/ENNReal/Basic.lean:177), so `ENNReal.inv_zero : (0 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = ∞` (Mathlib/Basic/ENNReal/Inv.lean:54) — the opposite of the older `0⁻¹ = 0` convention. Hence the excluded case `a ≤ 0` is trivial: `ENNReal.ofReal a = 0` (`ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero`, Mathlib/Basic/ENNReal/Real.lean:181), so `(ENNReal.ofReal a)⁻¹ ^ 8 = ∞ ^ 8 = ∞` (`ENNReal.top_pow`, Mathlib/Basic/ENNReal/Operations.lean:231), and `∞ * moment8 = ∞` (`ENNReal.top_mul`, Operations.lean:193) provided `moment8 ≠ 0`. That last fact holds: `moment8 = (eLpNorm (id : ℝ → ℝ) 8 (gaussianReal 0 1)) ^ 8`, and `eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff (p := 8) (by norm_num)` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSeminorm/Basic.lean:960) reduces `eLpNorm … = 0` to `id =ᵐ[gaussianReal 0 1] 0`, which is false because `nullSingletonClass_gaussianReal (μ := 0) (v := 1) (by norm_num)` (Mathlib/Probability/Distributions/Gaussian/Real.lean:233) gives `NullSingletonClass (gaussianReal 0 1)`, hence `Measure.ae_ne : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ≠ 0` (NullSingletonClass.lean:68) while `ae (gaussianReal 0 1)` is nontrivial (probability measure). So `moment8 ≠ 0`, and the whole right-hand side is `∞`, which dominates any `ℝ≥0∞`. A proof of the hypothesis-free statement is: `rcases le_or_lt a 0`; in the `a ≤ 0` branch rewrite with `ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr`, `ENNReal.inv_zero`, `ENNReal.top_pow (by norm_num)`, `ENNReal.top_mul hmoment8` and close with `le_top`; in the `a > 0` branch reuse the existing proof (with `ha` as a local hypothesis). The statement itself is unchanged, and the case `a = 0` is covered by the same computation ({ω | 0 ≤ |ω i|} = univ has measure 1 ≤ ∞). Note this judgement depends on the current `0⁻¹ = ⊤` convention; under the old convention `ha` would be necessary. The only other argument, `i : Index`, occurs in the statement (`ω i`), so it cannot be deleted.
